UC Berkeley Library Dataverse is a repository for datasets licensed  for use in research, teaching, and learning, as well as research data generated by UC Berkeley faculty. It is managed by the Library's [Data + Digital Scholarship Services](https://www.lib.berkeley.edu/research/data-services).
